title: 第10章 被领养了第11章 一双慧眼

第一卷 重生归来 第十章 被领养了
苏芮躺在拔步床上，思考着重生以来发生的事情，她的重生没能阻止父母的死亡，但是她没被李福夫妇收养，还被神秘老人柳青云收为徒弟。这是一个好的开始，她一定不会再让自己的家人受伤。父母还有些遗物在家里，明天一定要拿回来。想着想着，苏芮就睡着了。
已经陷入沉睡的苏芮和躺在床头看书的柳青云不知道，在书房中，那个古朴的盒子里，那个白玉扳指，发出不正常的光芒。
第二天一大早，苏芮醒过来看到拔步床上雕刻着的花纹，终于接受了自己已经重生了的事实。
起床，洗漱，刚到前院就看到师父柳青云在院子中盘腿坐在一个蒲团上，双手交叠，放在腹部。让苏芮觉得师父离她很遥远。
可能是感受到苏芮来了，柳青云睁开眼睛，不知是不是错觉，苏芮在柳青云睁开眼的瞬间，看到了一阵紫光闪过。
“起来了就去做早饭吧，随意做一点。今天带你去派出所。”
“是，师父。”
苏芮简单的做了白粥和小菜。师徒两人吃完了就向户籍所进发了。
当看到师父柳青云推出不知放在哪的自行车时，苏芮嘴角不觉的抽搐，试想一下，哪个世外高人会骑自行车？腾云驾雾苏芮都不觉得奇怪，可是骑自行车。苏芮不由的脑补了一下，实在是恶寒的不行。
由柳青云带着，苏芮坐在后座，很快就到了户籍所。看到户籍所的大门，苏芮还在想。怎么感觉比坐车要快？
来到户籍所，柳青云立马变得冷艳高贵，和之前骑自行车的样子，简直就是两个人。老板亲自接待，人家愣是一个眼神都没给。端着水杯，时不时的抿一口。不知道的还以为他喝得是大红袍。其实就是白开水…直到被通知的大Boss赶到，才用下巴指了指苏芮，开口道“我要领养她，办手续吧。”
那Boss连忙，弯腰称是。回过头交代手下，赶快让人去办。而自己则在柳青云身边站着。
很快领养手续就办好了，苏芮没有奇怪，毕竟前世她也做了几年苏家大小姐。
“那个李福，扰乱社会安宁，还是不要让他在外面呆着比较好。”柳青云平淡的好像在说今天天气真好一样。
“这…确实该让李福去改造改造，先生您真是太为人民着想了，在下一定会办好这件事的。”说罢，在那憨厚正直的脸上露出讨好的表情。真是毫无违和感。让人不忍直视。
感觉自家师傅好像有点不耐烦了，而且杯子中的白开水貌似也要见底，在自家师傅发飙前，苏芮赶忙说“师傅我们回去吧，徒儿还要去拿父母的遗物。”
柳青云给苏芮一个赞赏的眼神。放下茶杯，站起来整了整本来就很平整的衣服，开口道“那我们就先走了。”说罢，也不等人回应，就朝外走去。苏芮当然是紧紧跟着。
走到户籍所大门口，苏芮看到那辆自行车，回头看看后面跟出来的局长等人，在心里思考，这下怎么办，如果让他们看到师父骑车，形象立马破灭有木有。
谁知柳青云走出派出所大门，根本没看那自行车一眼，然后苏芮就看到一辆红Ｘ轿车停到了他们面前，从副驾驶下来一个人，替柳青云开门，苏芮看到这阵势，自觉地走到车的另一边，

九几年的派出所工作效率还是比较高的，所以还在家跟老婆核算得到赔偿款如何花的李福就被带进派出所。然后以一堆罪名送进了监狱。任王春花如何撒泼痛哭也弄不出来。而乡亲们知道了也只会在家偷着笑他遭报应了，为民除害，简直不要太大快人心了。
这边，苏芮坐在车里虽然心中有疑问，但是毕竟是从21世纪来的，而且知道了师傅的身份，所以对红X轿车一点也不好奇。虽然车牌子很特别，她也只是淡定的坐在后座上。
她淡定，前面的男子就不淡定了。虽然九几年汽车很多，但是能坐上红Ｘ，还是特别牌照的，那就不是一般人啊，这个小女孩怎么这么淡定。
杜言清了清喉咙，开口道“我叫杜言，是…是先生的秘书。请问你是？”
柳青云只是在杜言开口的时候看了他一眼，然后就把视线移到别处。不过那一眼，也让发现了的杜言心惊胆战。
“我是苏芮，师傅的徒弟。”
杜言的表情立马龟裂，艾玛，刚刚木有给未来主子开车门有木有！
嘤嘤嘤~不知道以后主子会不会给我穿小鞋~杜言心中的小人哭成狗了。
苏芮看到杜言脸上表情不停地变换，觉得这个人简直太牛了，居然能有这么多表情。以后无聊了可以逗一逗他找乐子。还不知道自己将来的命运已经被决定了的杜言，在未来的日子里无时无刻不希望自己成为面瘫。让我们默默地为杜言点上一根蜡。
“先去苏芮家收拾东西。”这时柳青云开口了。
“好的，先生。”听到柳青云的话，杜言立马收起苦逼的表情，变成一幅精英范。
很快，就到了苏芮家门口。苏芮的父母都是村子附近小学的代课老师，工资虽然不多，但是攒了几年还是盖了一处房子。不过房子还没住多久就出事了。
隔了一世在见到这座房子，苏芮忍不住想要落泪。但是师傅还在旁边，就忍住了。从门口花盆下拿出钥匙给菜园浇水的时候她总是想要帮忙，但是到最后却变成了捣乱，可是爸爸从来没责备过她，还会和她一起玩闹，而妈妈就会边洗衣服边微笑的看着他们父女亲近，目光温柔。
他们一家三口过得很幸福，虽然父母没有了之前的记忆，可还是记得自己的名字，而且，他们已经记起了很多事情了，所有的记忆碎片都被他们记在了日记本里，而她今天来，就是为了拿父母的日记本。
在这生活了十多年，遗物有很多，但是苏芮只拿了一些父母常穿的衣服，和爸爸每年送给妈妈的礼物，还有自己的一些衣物。所以很快就收拾好了。
苏芮怀里抱着两本笔记本，走出屋子。然后对杜言说“包裹在里面，谢谢。”
杜言很无语，但是他还是进去给自己未来主子拿行李。
苏芮最后看了一眼小院，然后锁上门。坐上车，离开。

Volume 1: Rebirth and Return Chapter 10: Adopted
Su Rui was lying on the bed, thinking about what had happened since her rebirth. Her rebirth failed to prevent the death of her parents, but she was not adopted by Li Fu and his wife, and was accepted as a disciple by the mysterious old man Liu Qingyun. This is a good start, and she will definitely not let her family get hurt again. My parents still have some relics at home, and I must get them back tomorrow. After thinking about it, Su Rui fell asleep.
Su Rui, who had fallen into a deep sleep, and Liu Qingyun, who was lying on the bedside reading, didn't know that in the study room, in the quaint box, the white jade finger ring was emitting an abnormal light.
Early the next morning, Su Rui woke up and saw the patterns carved on Babu's bed, and finally accepted the fact that she had been reborn.
Get up, wash up, and as soon as you arrive in the front yard, you see Master Liu Qingyun sitting cross-legged on a futon in the yard, with his hands folded and placed on his abdomen. It made Su Rui feel that Master was far away from her.
Perhaps feeling Su Rui coming, Liu Qingyun opened his eyes. I wonder if it was an illusion, but Su Rui saw a flash of purple light the moment Liu Qingyun opened his eyes.
"Let's make breakfast when we get up. Make whatever you want. I'll take you to the police station today."
"Yes, Master."
Su Rui simply made porridge and side dishes. After the master and apprentice finished eating, they headed to the household registration office.
When she saw Master Liu Qingyun pushing out a bicycle that he didn't know where to put, the corner of Su Rui's mouth twitched unconsciously. Just imagine, which outsider can ride a bicycle? Su Rui doesn't think it's strange to fly through the clouds, but riding a bicycle. Su Rui couldn't help but think about it, she really hated the cold.
Led by Liu Qingyun, Su Rui sat in the back seat and soon arrived at the household registration office. Su Rui was still thinking when she saw the door of the household registration office. Why does it feel faster than taking a car?
When he arrived at the household registration office, Liu Qingyun immediately became cool and noble. He looked exactly like two different people from the way he rode a bicycle before. The boss personally received me, but he didn't even look at me. Hold the glass of water and take a sip from time to time. Those who didn't know thought he was drinking Dahongpao. In fact, it was boiled water...until the big boss who was notified arrived, pointed at Su Rui with his chin, and said, "I want to adopt her, go through the formalities."
The Boss quickly bent down and said yes. Turn around and tell your subordinates to get them done as soon as possible. And he was standing next to Liu Qingyun.
The adoption procedures were completed soon, and Su Rui was not surprised. After all, she had been the eldest daughter of the Su family for several years in her previous life.
"That Li Fu disturbs social peace, it's better not to let him stay outside." Liu Qingyun said calmly, as if he was saying that the weather is really nice today.
"This...it's really time for Li Fu to renovate it. Sir, you really care about the people. I will definitely handle this matter well." After that, a flattering expression appeared on that honest and upright face. There is really no sense of contradiction. It's unbearable to look at.
She felt that her master was getting a little impatient, and the boiled water in the cup seemed to be bottoming out. Before her master got mad, Su Rui hurriedly said, "Master, let's go back. I have to go get my parents' belongings."
Liu Qingyun gave Su Rui an appreciative look. Putting down the tea cup, he stood up, straightened his already flat clothes, and said, "Then let's leave first." After that, he walked out without waiting for anyone to respond. Of course Su Rui followed closely.
Walking to the gate of the household registration office, Su Rui saw the bicycle, looked back at the director and others who were following behind, and thought to herself, what should I do now? If they see the master riding a bicycle, his image will be shattered immediately.
Unexpectedly, Liu Qingyun walked out of the police station door without even looking at the bicycle. Then Su Rui saw a red
In the 1990s, the work efficiency of the police station was still relatively high, so I was still working with my boss at home.Li Fu, whose mother-in-law was trying to figure out how to spend the compensation, was taken to the police station. Then sent to jail on a bunch of charges. No matter how much Wang Chunhua behaves and cries, she can't get it out of her. And when the villagers knew about it, they would only laugh secretly at home that he had suffered retribution. It was not very satisfying to eliminate harm for the people.
Here, Su Rui was sitting in the car, although she had doubts in her mind, but after all, she came from the 21st century and knew the identity of the master, so she was not curious about the red X car at all. Although the car brand was very special, she just sat calmly in the back seat.
She was calm, but the man in front of her was not. Although there were many cars in the 1990s, being able to ride in a red X with a special license plate meant that she was not an ordinary person. How could this little girl be so calm?
Du Yan cleared his throat and said, "My name is Du Yan. I am... Mr.'s secretary. Who are you?"
Liu Qingyun just glanced at Du Yan when he spoke, and then moved his eyes elsewhere. But that glance also made Du Yan frightened when he discovered it.
"I am Su Rui, the master's apprentice."
Du Yan's expression immediately cracked, Emma, did you open the door for your future master just now?
嘤嘘嘤~ I wonder if the master will let me wear small shoes in the future~ The villain in Du Yan's heart cried like a dog.
Su Rui saw the expressions on Du Yan's face constantly changing, and felt that this man was so awesome that he could have so many expressions. When he gets bored later, you can tease him for fun. Du Yan, who still doesn't know that his future destiny has been decided, hopes that he will become facial paralysis all the time in the days to come. Let us silently light a candle for Du Yan.
"Go to Su Rui's house to pack your things first." At this time Liu Qingyun spoke.
"Okay, sir." After hearing Liu Qingyun's words, Du Yan immediately put away his bitter expression and turned into an elite one.
Soon, we arrived at the door of Su Rui's house. Su Rui's parents are both substitute teachers at a primary school near the village. Although their salary is not much, they still built a house after saving for several years. But something happened to the house not long after we lived in it.
Seeing this house after a lifetime, Su Rui couldn't help but want to cry. But the master was still there, so he held back. When she took out the keys from under the flower pot at the door to water the vegetable garden, she always wanted to help, but in the end it turned into trouble. However, her father never scolded her and would play with her, while her mother would smile and watch the father and daughter get close to each other while washing clothes, with gentle eyes.
Their family of three lived happily. Although their parents had no previous memories, they still remembered their names. Moreover, they had remembered many things. All the memory fragments were recorded in their diaries. She came today to get her parents' diaries.
After living here for more than ten years, Su Rui had many relics, but Su Rui only took some clothes that her parents often wore, the gifts that her father gave to her mother every year, and some of her own clothes. So it was packed up quickly.
Su Rui walked out of the room with two notebooks in her arms. Then he said to Du Yan, "It's wrapped inside, thank you."
Du Yan was speechless, but he still went in to get his future master's luggage.
Su Rui took one last look at the small courtyard and then locked the door. Get in the car and leave.
